findings.title: Amount claimed differs from total bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital bill total payable and pharmacy bill total.

findings.title: Billed investigation lacks report
findings.detail: Investigation Charges are billed on the hospital bill, but no corresponding lab or investigation report for these charges is found in the file.

findings.title: Pharmacy items billed without prescription
findings.detail: Medications on the pharmacy invoice do not have a matching prescription dated prior to or during the pharmacy bill date in the file.
